clips.title: Agents Don't Lose IQ. They Lose Attention.
clips.summary: When an agent loops or hallucinates mid-task, the failure is usually not intelligence. It is an attention and memory collapse.

clips.title: Flat Vector Memory Becomes a Security Hole
clips.summary: Dumping every document into one memory channel does not just add noise. It creates retrieval drift and opens a path for hidden text to override guardrails.
